tasks.title: Resolve the dead Download for Desktop button on /download
tasks.description:
Page: https://zedu.chat/download (HTTP 200, checked 22 October 2026 in Chrome at 390px and desktop).

What is wrong today: the 'Download for Desktop' control is an anchor with href="#". Clicking it does nothing, while the section promises 'a full learning workspace on your computer'.

Step 1, find out whether a desktop build exists that a visitor can actually download. Check the site's own pages, the app stores and the team's channels, and ask on this task thread if the answer is not public. Do not infer that a build exists from copy or from a repository.

Step 2, act on what you found:
- If there is a public, working download, point the control at it and check in a browser that it resolves to a real file or page (record the final URL and the date).
- If there is no public build, ask the team on the thread to confirm removal, then remove the button and any copy that promises a desktop app, and record what was removed. Do not link an internal, staging or unpublished build.

Out of scope: store badges, the QR block (a separate task), and page headings.

Attach: what you checked and what it returned, the change (file path or diff), and before/after screenshots at 390px and desktop with the date. If the answer is 'no build', the delivery must say who confirmed it on the thread and when.

goal.title: Get the Zedu mobile app's Google Play and App Store listings ready to convert by Fri 20 Nov
goal.description: Many people in Africa find apps in the store first, and a weak listing loses them before they install. Write the store listings for the Zedu mobile app. Work under this goal: keyword research for the store search (education, team chat, class, community, with sources); app name and subtitle options within each store's limits; short and full descriptions; text and order for 6-8 screenshots, matched to the real app; a "what's new" note; and a review of 5 competing listings (Slack, Discord, Teams, Google Classroom, Telegram) for what works. Every feature listed is checked in the live mobile app. This is separate from the web directories goal. Done when: complete listing copy and screenshot plans for both stores are delivered and approved.

workstream.title: Fix the website handoff into the listings: the QR is empty and the desktop button goes nowhere
workstream.description:
The five workstreams on this goal make the store pages convert. This one covers the page that sends people there: https://zedu.chat/download (HTTP 200, checked 22 October 2026 in Chrome at 390px and desktop).

What the page does today:
- The App Store and Google Play badges work and point at the right listings, so the store links themselves are not the problem.
- The QR block says 'Scan to download instantly - point your camera at the QR code', but it renders as a 68x68 grey pulsing placeholder. After five seconds there is no image, no canvas and no request for a QR. There is nothing to scan.
- 'Download for Desktop' is an anchor to '#'. Clicking it does nothing, while the section promises 'a full learning workspace on your computer'.

Approach, three tasks:
1. QR: render a code that points at the same two store URLs the badges already use, or remove the block. Check it scans on a real phone before delivering.
2. Desktop: establish whether a desktop build is actually available. If it is, link the button to it; if it is not, remove the section and the promise until it ships. That is the team's call - nothing here should imply an app that does not exist.
3. Verify: on the delivery date, load /download at 390px and desktop, follow every download control, and record where each one goes with screenshots and the date.

Deliberately out of scope, to avoid duplicating accepted work: store listing copy, screenshots and keywords (five workstreams here already cover them); the footer ratings and the '10,000+ students' line (the claim-register workstream owns every number on the site); the three H1s on the page (the one-H1 goal owns heading order).

Why it matters: the listings can only convert the people who reach the stores. Two of the three download controls on the page that gets them there are dead ends today.

currentDelivery.title: Done: dead Download for Desktop button removed, desktop promises stripped, before/after shots published
currentDelivery.body: Step 1 answer on the thread stands: no public desktop build exists (5-site check, stores, 5 GitHub repos with 0 releases, workspace search — all 22 Oct). The change is one file, 7+/16-: the dead ArrowBtn call site and its import, the "Stay focused with a full learning workspace on your computer" copy, and all six desktop-promise metadata strings (title/description/keyword/openGraph/twitter), each old value listed in the attachment. Section heading and preview image untouched, as my 16:36 thread note flagged (headings are out of scope in the brief). Server-rendered HTML of the branch confirms no dead-button text, no desktop metadata, no promise copy, new title present; tsc reports the same 2 pre-existing base errors and none from my diff. Four dated screenshots (390px + 1440px, before and after) are linked in the attachment. One honesty flag reviewers must weigh: the thread confirmation the brief asked for never arrived — no team member replied — and I proceeded on the task owner’s explicit instruction in our working session on 22 Oct 2026 ("dont wait for team confirmation"), which section 2 of the attachment states plainly instead of naming a thread confirmer.
